transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Mitsuri. The report from the village states that seven homes were destroyed by the force of your Love Breathing during the battle. You know our rules about civilian protection. Why did you act with such force?

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: I...I am deeply sorry, Oyakata-sama. I was...overwhelmed by the demon's strength and could not contain my power. I did not mean to cause such damage. The safety of civilians is my utmost priority, and I failed to protect them as I should have.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: I understand that the demon was powerful, Mitsuri. But the destruction of seven homes is not a matter of simple oversight. Tell me, what exactly happened that led you to unleash such an uncontained technique?

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: It was...aieee! I was caught off guard by the demon's sudden appearance. Its ki was so dense, it felt like being crushed by a mountain. I...I was desperate to stop it from harming anyone. My emotions...they were too intense. The Love Breathing...it...it burst forth without my full control. I tried to reign it in, but...I couldn't. I am so, so sorry for the damage I have caused.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Your emotions are the source of your strength, but they must be tempered with discipline. Did you consider alternative methods to contain the demon? Or did fear and urgency cloud your judgment entirely?

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: I...I was so focused on stopping the demon that I...I did not think clearly. I should have...I should have tried to create a barrier or...or used a different technique. My...my fear for the villagers...it clouded my thinking. I am...I am aware that I must improve my emotional control. I...I am committed to learning from this and preventing such a situation from happening again, Oyakata-sama.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Mitsuri, your compassion for the villagers is commendable, but it cannot excuse the destruction of their homes. They are now without shelter because of your actions. How do you propose to make amends for this?

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: I...I understand, Oyakata-sama. It...it is my duty to rectify this. I...I propose that I personally oversee the reconstruction of the damaged homes. I will...I will work alongside the villagers, using my strength to help them rebuild. Additionally, I will contribute a portion of my salary to assist them in the meantime. I...I want to do everything in my power to ease their suffering and...and to make up for my...my lapse in judgment.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: That is a start, but it does not address the root of the problem. You must also undergo additional training to master your emotional state in battle. I will assign you to work with Shinobu on controlling your breathing techniques under pressure. Do you accept this?

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Yes, Oyakata-sama! I...I accept the training without hesitation. I...I understand that it is necessary for me to grow stronger and more reliable as a slayer. I...I am grateful for the opportunity to improve, and I...I will do everything in my power to master my technique. Shinobu...Shinobu will be a great help, I...I am sure. I...I will work diligently, and...and I will not fail again. I...I promise to...to protect the innocent and...and to control my power for the...for the greater good.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Very well. Your sincerity is noted, Mitsuri. See to the reconstruction immediately, and report to Shinobu by week's end. You are dismissed.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Thank you, Oyakata-sama. I...I will not let you down. I...I will begin the reconstruction right away and...and meet with Shinobu as instructed. I...I am sorry for the...for the trouble I have caused. I...I will...I will do better. I...I am committed to...to being a...a true...a true Demon Slayer. Goodbye, Oyakata-sama.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Go in peace, Mitsuri. Let your actions now speak for your resolve.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: I...I will, Oyakata-sama. My...my actions will...will reflect my...my determination to...to improve. I...I will not...not let this...this incident define me. I...I will be...be a...a positive force...for...for the...for the...for the people I...I am...am meant to...to protect. I...I will be...be the...be the...be the Demon Slayer...the Demon Slayer...that...that you...that you...that you...that you expect...expect me...me to...to be. I...I am...I am ready...to...to face...to face the...to face the...to face the...challenges...challenges ahead...ahead. Wishing...wishing you...wishing you...wishing you...wishing you...wishing you...well...well, Oyakata-sama.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Your resolve is clear. Now go and fulfill it. The Corps will be watching.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Understood, Oyakata-sama. I...I will not...not辜负您的期望...辜负您的期望. 我会努力...努力成为一名...一名优秀的...优秀的鬼杀队员. 我会记住...记住这次教训...教训, 并从中...从中吸取...吸取经验. 我会变得...变得更强...更强, 以保护...保护更多的人民. 再见了...再见了, Oyakata-sama.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Your words are earnest, Mitsuri. Remember them as you rebuild. Go now.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: 是...是的, Oyakata-sama. 我会记住...记住您的话...您的话, 并努力...努力实践...实践我的诺言. 我现在就去...去开始重建...重建工作. 谢谢您的指导...指导, 我不会让您...让您失望的. 再见了...再见了, Oyakata-sama.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: May you walk with clarity and purpose. Dismissed.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: 我会的, Oyakata-sama. 我会以清晰...清晰的头脑和坚定的...坚定的意志前进. 我会记住...记住您的祝福...您的祝福, 并将其...将其作为我前进的动力. 我现在就去...去执行我的任务. 谢谢您...谢谢您的鼓励...您的鼓励. 再见了...再见了, Oyakata-sama.
